clinical_study.brief_title: Zero-Latency Clinical Decision Support for Acute Poisoning and Toxidromes in Emergency Care (POCKET-TOX)
clinical_study.official_title: A Multi-Center, Stepped-Wedge Cluster Randomized Trial Evaluating a Zero-Latency Multi-Paradigm Clinical Decision Support System for Acute Toxidrome Triage and Antidote Protocolization

collaborator.agency: World Health Organization Programme on Chemical Safety

brief_summary.textblock: This stepped-wedge cluster randomized controlled trial evaluates whether the PocketGull zero-latency Clinical Decision Support (CDS) engine accelerates definitive antidote administration, prevents harmful home decontamination practices, and reduces 30-day mortality among patients presenting with acute toxic exposures (organophosphates, plant alkaloid cardiotoxins, opioids, anticholinergics).

study_design_info.masking: None (Open Label with Blinded Central Adjudication)

primary_outcome.time_frame: From emergency triage registration to first antidote administration (up to 6 hours)
primary_outcome.description: Elapsed minutes to verified intravenous Atropine, Pralidoxime (2-PAM), Naloxone, or Magnesium administration.

secondary_outcome.description: Proportion of patients deceased from acute poisoning complications within 30 days of index presentation.

secondary_outcome.measure: Incidence of Harmful Non-Guideline Folk Decontamination
secondary_outcome.time_frame: During acute pre-hospital and emergency encounter
secondary_outcome.description: Documentation of forced caustic emesis, unregulated herbal antidote tea delays, or gastric lavage without airway protection.

intervention.description: Client-side zero-latency clinical decision support providing toxidrome triage, weight-adjusted antidote dosing endpoints, and contraindication guardrails.

criteria.textblock:
Inclusion Criteria: - Age >= 12 years - Presenting within 6 hours of known or suspected acute toxic ingestion or inhalational exposure - Triage vitals recorded
Exclusion Criteria: - Out-of-hospital cardiac arrest without ROSC prior to arrival - Terminal chronic illness under active hospice care
